comment: Context assumptions: The guidance appears to assume the existence of uniformly strong governance, connectivity, and digital capacity. In the Philippine context, the devolved health system and varying levels of readiness among local government units mean that these conditions cannot be taken for granted. The availability of reliable connectivity and nationally adopted digital identity credentials may also be uneven.
